text_block_list.text:
After our outing, I was at a photobook
release event together with Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As expected of King-san and the Entourage!!
Your comedic timing between the straight man and the funny one was exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just seeing the three of them perform is amazing enough,
plus getting the best of both a talk show and a mini-live!
I seriously wanna send a thank-you letter to the organizers!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Digital-san, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Howaah!? K-King-san!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I need to talk to you. Not here, though... follow me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeehhhh~~~?!
I-I'm the stand-in?!"

King Halo asked Agnes Digital to fill in
for the live concert, as one of her entourage
was apparently feeling unwell.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I could never do it... it's impossible for me...
Such a huge responsibility...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You always come to cheer for me, don't you?
So I thought you'd be able to sing my song, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
B-But... if I go on stage unprepared
and ruin King-san's precious concert...!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...King, you can't help it.
There's no way you could just step in as a substitute on such short notice."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Do we really have no choice...
but to cancel it like this...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: If it's Digital, you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Are you really going to leave your fave in a bind?
Are you really going to leave your fave in a bind?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King-san! If you're okay with me,
I'll... happily step in as your substitute!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That was wonderful, Digital-san!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take full responsibility for this stage!
Don't worry about a thing,
just enjoy King's live to the fullest!"

And then the mini-live began.
Agnes Digital put on a perfectly synchronized performance
alongside King Halo and the others.

As the crowd cheered, the song reached its interlude.
âSuddenly, my eyes met Agnes Digital's.
Her gaze seemed to demand something...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I showed up out of nowhere, you're cheering for me too...
How exceptionally kind of you all!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Still, there is no need to worry about me.
A live show is a place to shout your love for your favorites.
Surely you all have someone else you wish to shout for?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone! Do not hold back, let your voices ring out!
Pour in all the love you have!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: King Halooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
Very well, I shall answer all your expectations!

Afterward, King Halo's performance
got the crowd wildly excited!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You really hyped them up, Digital-san.
I thank you from the bottom of my heart. I'll properly repay you another day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
I'm glad the mini-live was so lively.
choice_data_list: You were awesome at hyping up the crowd!
You were great at hyping up the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've actually been practicing hyping up the crowd for a while.
I figured there might come a time to use it during a Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Even when I'm on stage,
I want the horse girls to shine!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Your cheering was spot on too, Trainer,
so I think the audience section is in good hands!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep firing up the Umamusume together,
both from the stage and from the audience!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King-san! Everyone's waiting for you!
You're up!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Here I go!
My name is—huh?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Resonating more than anyone?

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Such a lovely, beautiful voice!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What about this stage?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Shining brilliantly!
The Umamusume who looks best under the spotlight~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Indeed! When one speaks of a first-class Umamusume, they mean me!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: King Halo!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! We're just getting started!
Be intoxicated by this King's brilliance!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You were flawless as a stand-in, Digital-san.
I'm truly grateful. I'll properly repay the favor another day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... Praise from King-san...?
Today is officially King-san Memorial Day!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You're the one who set up the King Call, Trainer! GJ!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
On today's stage, the fans were really expecting
a performance that only King-san and her Entourage could deliver, after all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...With this, I can focus on the Winning Live without worry,
leaving the cheering from the audience in Trainer-san's hands."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep firing up the Umamusume together,
both from the stage and from the audience!
I turned on the penlights that Agnes Digital left behind and held one in each hand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a beautiful sea of lights!
Look, the whole audience is glowing in your colors, King!
As Agnes Digital said that, the penlights changed color all at once, dyeing the audience in King Halo's color.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, truly, how lovely!
Everyone has such a wonderful mindset.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Then King must live up to those expectations as well!

Afterward, King Halo's fan service
got the crowd wildly excited!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You really hyped them up, Digital-san.
I thank you from the bottom of my heart. I'll properly repay you another day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fuhii~~~...
Did I manage to uphold King-san's honor?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's my line, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The passion you put into waving those penlights...
I saw it all clearly from the stage!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I want to show my oshi the most incredible view"—
Trainer, I felt that heart of yours!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...With this, I can focus on the Winning Live without worry,
leaving the cheering from the audience in Trainer-san's hands."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep firing up the Umamusume together,
both from the stage and from the audience!
